what: RPM makes coatings and sealants: Rust-Oleum paint for consumers, Tremco roofing and waterproofing for commercial buildings, and industrial coatings for floors and infrastructure.
customers: Hardware stores and home centres for the consumer brands, and contractors and building owners for the commercial ones.
money: Tremco roofing systems, sealants and waterproofing
Rust-Oleum, Zinsser and DAP sold through retailers
moat: Brands contractors and homeowners ask for by name, plus roofing systems sold with long warranties that tie the building owner to RPM for maintenance.
risks: Raw materials are oil-derived chemicals whose prices move faster than list prices
Consumer paint demand follows house moves and home improvement spending
opportunities: $706M of free cash flow and an 8.4% net margin after a multi-year cost programme
Revenue grew from $6.7B to $7.9B in four years
The dividend has been raised every year for over fifty years, which few companies can claim
watch: Volume growth separate from price, and whether the margin programme keeps delivering.
